data.one_liner: Comprehensive clipboard access package supporting rich text, images, and custom data formats.
data.what_it_does: Provides low-level and platform-agnostic clipboard reading and writing capabilities for Flutter applications. Supports standard formats like plain text, HTML, and images across Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_when: You need to read or write rich text, HTML, or images to the system clipboard.
You want cross-platform clipboard support including desktop and web.
You need to provide alternative representations of data on demand.
avoid_when: You only need basic string-only clipboard operations already covered by standard Flutter or lighter plugins.
You want to avoid native Rust dependencies or automated toolchain downloads during build.
strengths: Supports rich media formats like images and HTML out of the box.
Works across a wide range of platforms including desktop and web.
Supports custom data formats and lazy/on-demand data providing.
weaknesses: Uses Rust internally, which increases build setup complexity and first-build times.
Requires NDK configuration and custom provider definitions on Android for certain features.
Plugin is in early stages of development and experimental.
data.setup_notes: Requires Rust toolchain (or automatically downloads precompiled binaries/rustup). Android requires setting minSdkVersion to at least 23 and adding a content provider in AndroidManifest.xml for writing images and custom data.
